example_reasoning_model._comment: Thinking models burn tokens on hidden reasoning; give them a big budget or content comes back empty with finish_reason=length.

example_no_auth._comment: Omit auth_env for an endpoint that needs no Authorization header.

example_vendor_params._comment: Extra provider-specific fields go straight into the request body.

example_wiro_async._comment: Wiro.ai is ASYNC (submit -> poll Task/Detail), NOT OpenAI-compatible. Use src/wiro_bench.py, not bench.py. Auth is x-api-key only (env WIRO_API_KEY). Output is inline at outputs[0].content.answer, wrapped in <answer>..</answer>.
